hero.name: Robert Stickler
hero.title: Software Engineer & Solution Architect
hero.description: From mechanics to software – I enjoy solving complex problems. As a Software Engineer at Avanade Austria, I build solutions that automate processes and make teams more productive.

about.title: About Me
about.name: Robert
about.bio1: My path into IT wasn't straightforward – from mechanical engineering through an exchange semester in Iowa to software engineering. This diversity helps me approach problems from different perspectives and find practical solutions.
about.bio2: At Avanade Austria, I work at the intersection of technology and business. I don't just write code – I guide projects from initial requirements analysis to handover. Teamwork, mentoring, and direct client communication are part of my daily routine.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Development and automation of business processes using Microsoft Power Platform and C#/.NET backend
Leading the digitalization and automation of the fee note system for external contractors
Building a secure portal while meeting strict data protection requirements
Automated PDF generation and approval workflows for ~500 fee notes per week
Managing SQL Server, Firebase, and Azure Services (Web Jobs, App Registration)
Creating technical specifications, requirements analysis, and pre-sales support
Independent client consulting and architecture decisions
Mentoring junior developers and conducting internal trainings
